subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O @ P # T + G - V’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc1d26326b67b2e11bb280f873cc8f0082771fb043ec27b8a6ec99b1d9b6b87a.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

-

**Meaning**

 
 
 
sister

 
 
 
brother

 
 
 
wife

 
 
 
father

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

 

Given: O @ P # T + G - V

It means: O is the brother of P, P is the father of T, T is the sister of G, G is the wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3533e6fa0ef05603d916976f2c46f8c96d25e82de2f2a054db5bfdf2e3c989d.png] 

Thus, O is V's Wife's father's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
